name: Duty To Others
overview: Scripture calls believers to demonstrate Christlike love and humility in their relationships with others, reflecting God's character through acts of kindness, mercy, and patience as described in Colossians 3:12. Christians are urged to let their good works shine openly, so that others may glorify God (Matthew 5:16), while prioritizing God’s kingdom above all (Matthew 6:33). The New Testament further instructs believers to bless those who persecute them and to fulfill the law by loving one another without owing anything else (Romans 12:14; Romans 13:8). This duty to others is rooted in the revelation given by God to His servants, guiding the church in faithful living (Revelation 1:1).
